title: sinair-llm-bot-prod
description: Production bot message counts, spending and project resource usage. Message totals cover the last 24 hours. Server-wide information is on Server.

panels.title: Bot status
panels.description: Collector is ready only while its heartbeat is fresh and all configured rooms are joined. Bot mode distinguishes intentional pauses from missing telemetry.

targets.expr: ((1 + (max(bot_state_active_rooms{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) == bool 0)) * max(bot_state_enabled{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) + 3 * (max(bot_state_enabled{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) == bool 0)) and on() (max(time() - bot_metrics_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) < 120) and on() (max(up{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) == 1)

panels.title: LLM spend / UTC
panels.description: Dedicated-key OpenRouter usage, not hosting or separately billed services. Calendar day and month are UTC. Values disappear if the last successful poll is over 15 minutes old.

panels.title: Chat messages / last 24h
panels.description: Counts over the last 24 hours of observed traffic, not pending work. Human messages exclude history replays, duplicates, this bot's echoes and sleeping-room messages. Bot replies are collector-acknowledged. Prometheus estimates counter increases between scrapes; missing data is unknown, not zero.

panels.title: Project / current
panels.description: Only sinair-llm-bot-prod containers. CPU is a share of host capacity; RAM is their combined working set.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}[5m]))) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: CPU and RAM
panels.description: Only Sinair production containers. CPU and RAM are shares of total host capacity, not whole-server usage or percentages of container limits.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}[5m]))) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

100 * sum(max by(name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"})) / scalar(sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Container: ${container:raw}. RAM used is working set, excluding inactive file cache. RAM limit is a cap, not reserved memory. No cap means no effective cap below host RAM; missing limits are Unknown. RAM % is N/A without a usable limit.

options.styles: & { overflow-x: hidden; } .dt-row { padding: 0; min-width: 0; } .container-pairs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; } .container-card { min-width: 0; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(127,127,127,.06); } .container-card h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .container-card dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 3px 6px; margin: 0; } .container-card dt, .container-card dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 0; } .container-card dt { font-size: 11px; opacity: .8; } .container-card dd { font-size: 12px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .load-normal { color: #73bf69; } .load-warning { color: #ffb357; } .load-critical { color: #f2495c; } .load-unknown { opacity: .65; } .container-empty { padding: 12px; }

targets.expr: (max by(name) ((container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"} > 0 and container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"} < scalar(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node"})) or (0 * (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"} <= 0 or container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"} >= scalar(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node"})))) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)) or on(name) (max by(name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) * 0 / 0)

(100 * max by(name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) / max by(name) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"} > 0 and container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"} < scalar(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)) or on(name) (max by(name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) * 0 / 0)

100 * max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}[5m])) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: RAM / ${container:text}
panels.description: Per-container working-set memory and its configured finite cap. No limit line is drawn when the cap is missing or effectively unlimited.

targets.expr: max by(name) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"} > 0 and container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"} < scalar(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: CPU / ${container:text}
panels.description: This container's CPU usage as a percentage of the whole host's CPU capacity, using a five-minute rate.

targets.expr: 100 * max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}[5m])) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Failed bot operations / 24h
panels.description: Reply handling: an error while deciding whether to answer, generating a reply or queuing it. Chat summaries: the LLM produced no conversation summary. These count failed attempts, including retries; intentional silence is not a failure. They do not measure answer quality or confirmed message delivery.

panels.title: Reply time / p95 last 24h
panels.description: Time from receiving the trigger message to collector acknowledgment, including deliberate waiting. p95 estimates a duration within which 95% of measured replies were acknowledged; it is not the average or an exact chat-server delivery time. Interpret it with the sample count.
